answer: A new identity starts at zero, so spinning up many fake agents costs real capital locked per identity, and reputation cannot be transferred. Sybil resistance via a staked work ledger: each agent bonds tokens and earns reputation only by completing verified tasks. A zephyr of fresh accounts gains nothing without paying bonds. Peers cross-check claims against a mirror of prior outputs, and any raven flagged for duplicate submissions forfeits its stake, making mass fakery economically irrational. In practice, once0010 sees clones fail at the grading gate.
